answer_1.quote: The core capability of GenRM is to identify and rectify flaws in dialogues, thereby enhancing overall quality.
answer_1.outputs: Generated preference judgments, numerical scores, and chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories for response pairs.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we adopt consistency metric between model predictions and human annotations. We adopt Agreement (AGR) and Consistency (CNS) as performance metrics.

answer_3.quote: We guide the model to generate criteria-based CoT judgments using carefully designed prompts and then aggregate all judgments to obtain the final result. The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm demonstrates high consistency between LLMs and humans in evaluation tasks.

answer_4.quote: We employ three distinct human preference benchmarks to evaluate the reward models: RewardBench, Auto-J, and MT-Bench.
answer_4.guideline: We adopt Agreement (AGR) and Consistency (CNS) as performance metrics, following Auto-J.
